paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni khat in buhlei ah apaisuak a, anungzuite'n buhvuite akhiak ua, akhutpek ua nuaisiang in ane uhi.
heading: Sabbath Thu A Dotna / (Mat 12.1-8; Mar 2.23-28)

paite: Pharisai kuate hiam in, "Bangziak a Sabbath ni a hihsiang lou hih na hi ua?" achi uhi.
Jesu'n adawng a, "David agilkial lai a alawmte toh athilhih uh huai bangte leng na sim kei ua hia?
Huchi a Pathian inn a lut a, siampute lou ngal in anek siang louh tanghou koihtuam alak a, alawmte kiang a apiak sam thu," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath' Toupa ahi,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni dang khat in sinagog ah alut a, thu ahilh a; huai ah mi khat khut taklam zaw ana om hi.
heading: Pasal Khutzaw Hihdamna / (Mat 12.9-14; Mar 3.1-6)

paite: Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n ahekna ding amuhtheihna ding un, Sabbath ni in hihdam ding in akisa hia kisa lou asim et uhi.
Himahleh ama'n alungsim uh thei a, khutzaw kiang ah, "Thou inla, alai ah dingkhia in," achi hi. Huan athou a, adingkheta hi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihhoih asiang hia, hihsiat? Hotdam asiang hia, hihlup? K'on dong ahi," achi hi.
Huan avek un a-en velvel a, akiang ah, "Na khut zankhia in,” achi hi. Huan azankhia a, akhut adamta hi.
Huchi in aheh lo mahmah ua, Jesu tung a hihdan ding akihouta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai a kipan in apawt a, thum ding in tang ah akuan a, Pathian kiang ah zankhua in athum hi.
heading: Sawltak Sawm-le-nih Sehna / (Mat 10.1-4; Mar 3.13-19)

paite: Khua avaktak in anungzuite asam a; alak uah sawm-le-nih atel a, amin ding un leng Sawltakte asa hi.
Huaite Simon Peter achih leh a-unaupa Andru, Jakob leh Johan, Philip leh Bartholomai,
Matthai leh Thomas, Alphai tapa Jakob, Zealot kichi Simon,
leh Jakob tapa Judas leh amansakpa Judas Iskariot ahi uh.

Huan amau toh apaikhia a, mun zang ah adingh a, anungzui mipite toh, Judia gam tengteng a kipan leh Jerusalem a kipan leh Tura leh Sidon kholam a tuipi gei a kipan mipi tampitak athu ngainuam leh adamlouhnate uh hihdam ut in ahong pai uhi.
heading: Jesu Sinsakna leh Hihdamna / (Mat 4.23-25)

paite: Huchi in dawi nin sukbuaite leng damsak in a-omta uhi.
Huan akiang a kipan thilhihtheihna apawtkhia a, michih ahihdam zel ziak in mipi tengteng in amah khoih atum uhi.
Huan adakkhia a, anungzuite mitsuan kawm in agen a: "Nou gentheite aw, na hampha uh; Pathian lalgam nou a ahi ngal a.
heading: Hamphatna leh Tunggikna / (Mat 5.1-12)

paite: Nou tua gilkialte aw, na hampha uh, tai ding na hi ngal ua. Nou tua kapte aw, na hampha uh, nui ding na hi ngal ua."
"Mihing Tapa ziak a mite'n ahon huat ua, hon pampaih ua, hon tai ua, na min uh ahoih kei chi a ahon paihmang chiang un, na hampha ding uh.
Huai ni in kipak unla, nuam in tawm un, ngai un, van ah na kipahman uh a-om kihkeih hi; huchibang mah in apipute un zawlneite tung ah ahih uhi.”
"Himahleh, nou mihaute aw, na tung uh agik e; na khamuanna uh na mu khinta ngal ua;
nou tua vahte aw, na tung uh agik e; na gil uh ahong kial ding. Nou tua nuite aw; na tung uh agik e; lungkham a kap ding na hi ngal ua."
"Mi tengteng in ahon phat chiang un na tung uh agik ding hi; huchi mah bang in apipute un zawlnei takloute tung ah ahih uhi.
"Ka thu ngaikhete aw, ka hon hilh ahi, na melmate uh it unla, hon hote hoihna ding hih un,
heading: Melmate Itna / (Mat 5.38-48; 7.12a)

paite: Hon hamsiatte vualzawl unla, hon simmohte thumsak un.
Biang langkhat a hon bengpa alehlam leng doh in; na puan hon laksakpa kiang ah na puanak leng it ke'n.
Ahon ngen peuh kiang ah pia in; huan na van hon laksakpa kiang ah ngen nawn ke'n.
Huan mi'n na tung ua ahih ding uh na deih bang zel un mi tung ah leng hih sam un.
"Huan ahon itte kia na it un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng amau itte a-it sam ve ua oi!
Na tung ua hoihte tung kia a na hoih un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng huchibang mah in ahih zel ve ua oi.
Muh nawn lametnate kiang kia a thil na leitawisak un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng angeingei mu nawn ding in mikhialte kiang ah aleitawisak sam uhi.

Himahleh na melmate uh it unla, ahoihna ding un hih unla, lunglel het lou in leitawisak un; huchi in na kipahman uh atam dia, Tungnungpen tate na hi ding uh; ama'n mi kipahna dan theiloute leh migiloute ahehpih hi.
Na Pa azahngaih theih bang in zahngai thei in om un.
"Hawmsak kei un, huchi in hawmsak in na om kei ding uh; kuamah siam lou in sep kei un, huchi in siam louh in na om kei ding uh; ngaidam un, huchi in ngaihdam in na om ding uh;
heading: Midangte Dem Thu / (Mat 7.1-5)

paite: pia un, huchi in piak in na om ding uh, hoihtak a teh a, hen gak a, sin gak in, let nawinawi in na angsung uah piak in na om ding uh. Noumau tehna ngei mah a tehsak a piak in na om ding uh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, gentehna agen a: "Mittaw in mittaw mah api thei diam? Anih un kokhuk ah akekhawm kei ding ua hia?
Asinsakpa tung ah nungzui a-om kei; himahleh mi kuapeuh kisinsiamtate asinsakpa bang in a-om ding uh.
"Huan bangziak a na mit a singtum om limsak lou a, na unau mit a ninneng neuchik om mu na hia?

Nangmah mit a singtum om mu lou in, na unau kiang a, 'Unau, na mit a ninneng neuchik om hon lakhesak ve,' bangchi a chi thei na hia? Milepchiah na mit a pan singtum lakhe masa in, huchi in na unau mit a ninneng neuchik lakkhiak ding chiantak in na mu thei ding hi.
"Sing hoih gahsia a gah a-om ngei kei; sing sia lah gah hoih a gah a-om ngei sam kei hi.
heading: Sing leh Agah / (Mat 7.16-20; 12.33-35)

paite: Sing chih amau gah chiat ah akithei hi. Mi'n khaulingnei kung ah theipi alou ngei kei uh, loubukh lingnok lak ah grep gah alou ngei sam kei uh.
Mihoih in alungtang goubawm hoih a kipan thil hoihte alakhia a; migilou in alungtang goubawm sia a kipan thil hoihloute alakhe zel hi; alungtang a dim val kam in agen zel ngal a.
"Huan nou bang ding a, ka gente hihloupi a, Toupa, Toupa, hon chi na hi ua?
heading: Inn Lamdan Nihte / (Mat 7.24-27)

paite: Michih ka kiang a hong a, ka thu za a zui peuhmah kua bang ahi ua, ka hon ensak ding:
Amah zaw inn lammi in lei thukpi a tou a, suangpi tung a suangphum lem mi bang ahi; huan tui ahong khan in, tui khauh in huai inn akhoh a, ahihling thei kei; hoihtak a lam ahih ziak in.
Himahleh thu za a mang lou suangphum louh a leitung maimah a inn lammi ahi; tui khauh in huai inn akhoh a, achim pah a; huai inn siatna thupitak ahi,” achi hi.
